title: RNA-seq bulk of CCR6+Th-cell subsets in Crohn’s Disease, peripheral blood and intestinal lamina propria
description: This RNA seq experiment was designed to identify a gene signature of a CCR5-expressing subset of human intestinal Th17-cells. T helper-cells from peripheral blood of healthy donors and from the lamina propria of Crohn’s Disease patients were FACS-purified according to the expression of the chemokine receptors CCR6, CCR5 and CXCR3. Four CCR6+Th- subsets were isolated according to CXCR3 and CCR5 expression: two CXCR3- Th17 subsets (CCR5-: “cTh17” or CCR5+: “pTh17”) and two subsets of CXCR3+ Th1/17-cells (CCR5+ or CCR5-)

samples.title: SQ_2054
samples.description: Protocols: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells were magnetically enriched for CD4+ T-cells with a kit (Miltenyi). T-cells were stained with antibodies to CD4, IL-7R, CD25, CCR6, CXCR3 and CCR5 and purified on a FACS Aria (BD). CD4+IL-7R+CD25-/lo helper T-cells were purified as cTh17- (CCR6+CXCR3-CCR5-), pTh17- (CCR6+CXCR3-CCR5+), CCR5-Th1/17- (CCR6+CXCR3+CCR5-) or CCR5+Th1/17-cells (CCR6+CXCR3+CCR5+). RNA was isolated using mirVana Isolation Kit (ThermoFisher) Library construction was performed with the TruSeq RNA Sample Preparation Kit v2 (Illumina)
